options: It calculates the average coordinates of all overlapping boxes to produce a single refined box while suppressing the original set of boxes
It selects the box with the highest confidence score and suppresses remaining boxes that have high overlap with the selected box

questions.text: Which of the following statements are true regarding regularization?

Ridge regularization can be used to perform feature selection as it forces some weights exactly to zero
Regularization adds constraints to the model and can lead to an increase in bias while reducing the variance
Regularization can be used to increase sensitivity of the model to small changes in the input data
correct_answer: Regularization can be used when a model overfits, and it typically helps by reducing model complexity
Regularization adds constraints to the model and can lead to an increase in bias while reducing the variance
